text:
Alex Kim: FYI I'm stuck at the airport, flight delayed. can someone cover the overnight primary slot? I can do async handoff but won't be reachable for live paging for the 00:00-08:00 UTC window.

Priya Rao: @Alex Kim sorry to hear that. I can take primary for the first half (00:00-04:00 UTC) if Matt can pick up 04:00-08:00.

Matt Gonzalez: I can do 04:00-08:00 but need the short handoff checklist — anything in-flight? incident bot?

Alex Kim: No active incident right now. Last deploy was low-risk. Leaving runbook pointers below. main concerns are spikes in model latency or Dedicated capacity throttles.

Alex Kim: Runbooks: /runbooks/oncall/latency-surge.md and /runbooks/oncall/dedicated-capacity-fallback.md

Priya Rao: Noted. Also reminder: escalation policy is two-stage. page -> if not ack in 5m escalate to secondary -> if not resolved, escalate to oncall-lead.

oncall-bot: Incident ping test scheduled at 23:50 UTC. This is a scheduled health-check message, no real page.

Tina Chen: Quick check — primary/secondary today? I thought Tina was secondary overnight?

Alex Kim: Current rotation: Primary=Alex Kim, Secondary=Tina Chen. I'm swapping primary to Priya/Matt split as requested. Tina stays Secondary unless she opts out.

Tina Chen: I'm fine staying secondary. I'll monitor PagerDuty and be ready to escalate.

Matt Gonzalez: Confirming I'll take 04:00-08:00 UTC. Priya, want me to join the handoff call at 03:55 UTC? short 5m sync.

Priya Rao: Yes please. 03:55 sync sounds good. Alex, any last config knobs I should be aware of?

Alex Kim: Two quick things: 1) If you see token throughput jump >30% use the quick scale script:
```bash
ssh infra@ops 'sudo /opt/redwood/sbin/scale_pool --pool dedicated-main --delta +2'
```
2) If latency > 500ms check KV cache warmness and trigger cache invalidation only if cold rate >20% (see runbook).

Matt Gonzalez: Thanks. Also adding small note for customer-impact triage: if >=3 customers report errors in 15m, mark P1 and notify sales-ops with template in /incident-templates/customer-impact.md

Priya Rao: Acknowledged. I'll paste critical snippets in the handoff thread at 03:55.

Alex Kim: Thanks team, really appreciate the swap. I'll update the rotation dashboard now and post the updated screenshot to this thread. :airplane: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/2026-03-14-rc3 to prod at 22:47 UTC (no errors).

Priya Rao: Rotation updated in the dashboard, screenshot posted. All set for handoff.

Matt Gonzalez: Got it. See you both during the 03:55 sync. If page comes in while I'm bridging, I'll ack and transfer to Tina if needed.

Alex Kim: One last thing — please run a quick smoke check after any scale operation:
```bash
curl -sS https://health.redwood.internal/edge | jq .latency_95
```
if that looks off, revert scale and tag SRE slack channel.

Tina Chen: Copy. I'll be on standby for escalation. Good luck and safe travels Alex.

Alex Kim: Thanks, will DM any travel ETA updates. Appreciate you all.
